caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate teapot rendered in grayscale. The teapot is centered within a rectangular frame and features a prominent curved spout on the left and a decorative handle on the right, both rendered with shading to emphasize their three-dimensional forms. The body of the teapot is bulbous and fluted with vertical ridges, narrowing at the neck and then flaring out at the top to a domed lid with a small finial. The teapot sits on a circular pedestal base. In the top left corner and the bottom right corner of the composition, there are two smaller inset sketches; the upper left inset shows a top view and side profile of the spout, while the lower right inset includes a simplified outline of the whole teapot. The artist's name, "Eugene J. Barnell," is written in cursive at the bottom left of the main frame. The artwork uses various shades of gray to create depth and highlights, and the background is a plain, light color, allowing the object and its details to stand out clearly.
title: Pewter Coffee Pot
